description: This file defines the ProductCriteria class used to specify search or filtering criteria for products within the sales manager application. It includes various fields such as product name, category IDs, availability, attribute criteria, product IDs, and manufacturer ID, along with their respective getter and setter methods.

classes.name: ProductCriteria
classes.description: A criteria class for filtering products based on various attributes like name, categories, availability, manufacturer, etc.

methods.name: getProductName
methods.description: Returns the product name search criterion.

methods.name: setProductName
methods.description: Sets the product name search criterion.

methods.name: getCategoryIds
methods.description: Returns the list of category IDs to filter products.

methods.name: setCategoryIds
methods.description: Sets the list of category IDs.

methods.name: getAvailabilities
methods.description: Returns the list of availability statuses to filter products.

methods.name: setAvailabilities
methods.description: Sets the list of availability statuses.

methods.name: getAvailable
methods.description: Returns whether to filter for available products.

methods.name: getProductIds
methods.description: Returns a list of product IDs to filter.

methods.name: setProductIds
methods.description: Sets the list of product IDs.
